name: Call Centre Agent Emotion and Attitude Scoring
description: Webcams and microphones on call-centre agents' desks feed an emotion-recognition model that scores each agent's 'attitude' (smiles, tone, stress) every minute. The scores automatically feed monthly bonus calculations and a list of agents flagged for dismissal review.
documentation:
DATA: continuous webcam video of agents' faces, voice recordings, derived emotion and stress scores.
TRANSPARENCY: agents were not informed that their faces are analysed; the camera was introduced as 'for security'.
DECISION: scores directly and automatically change bonuses; bottom 5% are auto-listed for dismissal review.
SCIENTIFIC VALIDITY: no validation that facial expressions reflect performance; model not tested on Arabic-speaking or veiled employees.
VENDOR: foreign emotion-AI vendor; video processed abroad; no DPA.
OVERSIGHT: no appeal; supervisors cannot override scores.
RETENTION: video kept indefinitely.
